title: The Haunting of Hill House
author: Shirley Jackson
summary: A doctor interested in the supernatural invites a few guests to stay at a notorious old house. Shy, lonely Eleanor arrives hoping to belong somewhere, and the house takes notice of her.
readIf: you like horror that relies on atmosphere, ambiguity and beautiful, precise sentences.
skipIf: you want clear explanations and plenty of action.

pairings.reason: The same author's other classic, equally uneasy and about another isolated woman.
An older haunting story that also keeps you unsure what is real.
A more modern, vividly drawn haunted-house story with a stronger plot.
